build_SO2_Convolution: build an SO(2) convolution module for all m orders with optional radial weights and extra m0 gating channels
build_SO2_Linear: build an SO(2) linear layer for all m orders with optional radial function and coefficient mapping
build_SO2_m_Conv_Block: build an optimized SO(2) convolution block using block-diagonal GEMM for faster tensor core utilization on m greater than 0
build_SO2_Conv1_WithRadialBlock: build the first SO(2) convolution with radial block diagonal GEMM and extra m0 gating output channels
build_SO2_Conv2_InternalBlock: build the second SO(2) convolution with internal weights only using block diagonal GEMM and no radial function
